ns2:section.sectionText: This class will examine neurotransmitter, hormonal, and cell signaling mechanisms underlying learning and memory in laboratory rodents. The class is taught in seminar format, with all students responsible for weekly reading of primary literature, for contributing to class discussions, and for a formal presentation at least once during the semester on topics selected at the start of the course. No prerequisites, but students should have a solid background in molecular, cellular and behavioral neuroscience.
